verdict.rationale: An ecommerce platform with built-in AI features could plausibly let users connect external MCP servers, so this question applies to BigCommerce. Nothing in the evidence shows it can act as an MCP client. The AI-powered docs search and chat, AI-ready page actions, and llms.txt are adjacent AI features, not MCP server integration, and REST/GraphQL APIs are developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
